subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw change the canonical Chinese locale IDs from `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` to `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publish metadata, and generated i18n artifacts?
rationale: The request is semantically reasonable, but it crosses public locale values, saved browser state, generated artifacts, docs publishing, and stable CLI onboarding docs, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
options.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n assets, tests, docs, and saved browser preferences together in one reviewed compatibility-aware change.

options.title: Keep current region IDs
options.body: Treat `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's stable user-facing locale contract and continue improving terminology under those IDs.

options.title: Defer to broader i18n planning
options.body: Keep this issue as product backlog until maintainers settle the long-term localization contract and docs publish shape.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
recommendation.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n assets, tests, docs, and saved browser preferences together in one reviewed compatibility-aware change.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest routing candidate from the inspected locale contract blame, docs i18n history, and compatibility-policy surface.
